english.title: Cause / permit a animal to be brought into / remain in a Midland Metro vehicle / stop
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF ANIMAL..) to

(C)_[be brought into a vehicle]_
(D)_[be brought into a stop]_
